value.body:
Additional defect observed on evals-6f4fbf2aa69a (1,888 matches across 7 tournaments on mtg344-cpu32): courier._track() uploads tracked files sequentially on a single thread (~0.7s/PUT to R2, unlike _put_outputs which uses an 8-worker ThreadPoolExecutor) and publication() orders all block.json seals after all data files + thousands of artifacts/agents/protocol-*.json files across every tournament. A ~20-minute eval job spent >90 minutes uploading ~15k small files one-by-one while reporting 1/1888 matches until seals arrive. Parallelizing independent data-file PUTs in _track() (preserving seal-after-data ordering per block) and/or bundling protocol artifacts would cut eval delivery time by ~8x.
